from pathlib import Path
programs = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
task_file = programs / 'task-1499e2ef.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        marks = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 6]
        for left, right in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            if right - left == 2 and row[left] == row[right]:
                out[r][left + 1] = 2
    return out
'''
task_file.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(task_file), 'exec'), globals())

test_grid = [
[6,6,6,6,6,6,6,1,6,1,6,1,6,1,6,6],

]
demo_in = [[6]*29 for _ in range(20)]
for c in range(6,17,2): demo_in[14][c]=8
for c in range(3,22,2): demo_in[17][c]=8
demo_out = [row[:] for row in demo_in]
for r, start, end in [(14,6,16),(17,3,21)]:
    for c in range(start+1,end,2): demo_out[r][c]=2
print('demo reproduces:', transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
answer = transform(test_grid)
print('answer:')
print(answer)
